macros.name: asrsetkeys
macros.doc: \asrsetkeys is a more efficient alternative to \psset if all the keys which must be set are asr-keys.

macros.name: bare
macros.doc: The symbol is typeset on the timing tier at the current position, then the current position is advanced to the position of the next timing slot.

macros.name: DefList
macros.doc: pst-asr provides \DefList, which gives a convenient way to concentrate the parameters which might need to be adjusted.

macros.name: dput
macros.doc: The macro \dput is just like the PSTricks macro \rput, but adds the updating of the dimension registers which are used to set the size of the dbox.

macros.name: newtier
macros.doc: Executing \newtier{name} establishes four parameters: nameB, nameht, namedp, and name.

macros.name: xedcirc
macros.doc: \xedcirc is also available, which is used to indicate crossed association lines.
